headline: IFC Launches New Strategy to Address Africa's Long-Term Financing Gap
summary: The International Finance Corporation outlined a new investment strategy at AFIS in Angola aimed at tackling Africa's shortage of long-term financing, equity capital, and local-currency funding by leveraging fintech and cash-flow lending for MSMEs.
why: The IFC is the private-sector arm of the World Bank Group, providing vital development finance, advisory services, and asset management to emerging markets.

impacts.name: Angola
impacts.why: Inflows of development capital and fintech integration expand credit availability for regional small businesses.
